item.title: East Lake Family YMCA, Drew Charter School to celebrate 6th annual Black History Parade
item.description: The East Lake Family YMCA and Drew Charter School are hosting their sixth annual Black History Month parade Saturday, Feb. 7, at noon. item.title: High Museum Opens New Photography Exhibit: “Blazing Light Photographs by Mimi Plumb”
item.description: "Blazing Light Photographs by Mimi Plumb" is a solo museum exhibition opening at the High Museum of Art, featuring photographs from the early 1970s to recent images taken during ongoing drought conditions in the American West, exploring themes of suburban expansion, political tension, climate anxiety, and uncertainty about the future. item.title: ‘All of Us or None of Us’: Georgia Nurses Call for Stop to ICE and DHS funding
item.description: Nurses and supporters gathered outside a VA hospital in Atlanta to honor the life of Alex Pretti, a former VA intensive care nurse who was killed by ICE and border patrol agents, and to call for the abolition of ICE. item.title: “Ailey” screened at Art Farm at Serenbee on fifth anniversary of the film
item.description: "Ailey", a documentary on the life and work of award-winning choreographer Alvin Ailey, was screened at the Art Farm at Serenbee on February 7, and included early footage of Ailey's career, performances from the Alvin Ailey Dance Theater, and discussions from Ailey and others about the early days of the company.
